remarks: A wonderful opportunity to move into Shippan and walk the beach this Fall, as it is only FIVE HOUSES FROM THE BEACH.... This lovely 3 bedroom 2.5 bath home offers a open floor plan in great condition. The rooms are spacious, there is a large living room / dining area, laundry and half bath on main level. Three nice size bedrooms, Master Suite with dressing room and huge closet. Attic for storage. Full partially finished basement offers more storage space and a pool table. Off-street parking spaces, 2 in front of house. Nice deck for al-fresco dining. NO PETS. NO SMOKING. 2 months security deposit and good credit a MUST. Tenant responsible for yard care and snow removal, gutter cleaning, and gas contract. Owner prefers a TWO year lease, but will do 1 year. New hardwood flooring installed on main level. DO NOT PARK IN CENTER PART of driveway as it is a shared driveway. Avail Nov 5 or close.
